put.description: Replaces workbook file contents in Microsoft 365 Excel.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

driveId.description: Drive ID containing the workbook item. From Graph file output, use `parentReference.driveId`.

driveItemId.description: Drive item ID of the workbook file to replace. From the output shown, this is the top-level `id`.

workbookFile.description: Base64-encoded contents of a valid .xlsx workbook file. The action decodes this value and sends the raw workbook bytes to Microsoft Graph.

id.description: Drive item ID of the uploaded workbook.

put.description: Updates worksheet range values in Microsoft 365 Excel.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

driveItemId.description: Drive item ID of the Excel workbook file.

worksheetName.description: Worksheet name exactly as it appears in the workbook, such as Sheet1 or Summary.

startCell.description: Top-left cell in the target range, such as A1.

endCell.description: Bottom-right cell in the target range, such as B3.

values.description: Two-dimensional JSON array of cell values to write into the target range.

post.description: Uploads a workbook file to Microsoft 365 Excel.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

driveId.description: Drive ID for the destination drive. For a folder or file returned by Graph, use `parentReference.driveId`.

parentFolderId.description: Drive item ID of the destination folder. From the prior output shown, this is `parentReference.id`, not the workbook file `id`.

fileName.description: Workbook filename to create, including the `.xlsx` extension.

workbookFile.description: Base64-encoded contents of a valid .xlsx workbook file. The action decodes this value and sends the raw workbook bytes to Microsoft Graph.

id.description: Drive item ID of the uploaded workbook.

webUrl.description: URL to open the uploaded workbook.
